conbody.p: The radio has two antennas. Each antenna receives a different frequency band.
The telescopic antenna receives FM signals. It is mounted on the outside of the radio and can be extended. A fully extended antenna receives FM signals best.

The internal antenna receives AM signals. It is a ferrite antenna built into the radio housing. A ferrite antenna is directional, so AM reception depends on how the radio is positioned in relation to the transmitter.
